text.body: bhaṭaḥ- jayatu mahārājaḥ| rājā- āpastāvat| bhaṭaḥ- yadājñāpayati mahārājaḥ| (niṣkramya praviśya) imā āpaḥ| rājā- arjuna! gograhaṇavijayaśulkārthaṃ pratigṛhyatāmuttarā| bhagavān- etadavanataṃ śiraḥ | arjunaḥ- kathaṃ caritraṃ me tulayati| bho rājan! iṣṭamantaḥ puraṃ sarvaṃ mātṛvat pūjitaṃ mayā| uttaraiṣā tvayā dattā putrārthe pratigṛhyate || 71 || bhagavān- etadunnataṃ śiraḥ| rājā- idānīṃ yuddhaśūrāṇāṃ cāritreṣu vyavasthitaḥ| antaḥ puranivāsasya sadṛśīṃ kṛtavān kriyām || adyaiva khalu guṇavannakṣatram| adyaiva vivāhosya pravartatām| yudhiṣṭhiraḥ- bhavatu, bhavatu, pitāmahasakāśamuttaraṃ preṣayāmaḥ| rājāḥ- yadabhirucitaṃ bhavadbhyaḥ| dharmarājavṛkodaradhanañjayāḥ! ita ito bhavantaḥ| anenaiva praharṣeṇābhyantaraṃ praviśāmaḥ| sarveḥ- bāḍham (niṣkrāntāḥ sarve|) <4> tṛtīyo'ṅkaḥ tataḥ praviśati bhaṭaḥ|) bhaṭaḥ- bho bhoḥ! nivedyatāṃ nivedyatāṃ sarvakṣatrācāryapurogāṇāṃ kṣatriyāṇām| eṣa hi, apāsya nārāyaṇacakrajaṃ bhayaṃ cirapranaṣṭān paribhūya pāṇḍavān| dhanuḥ sahāyaiḥ kurubhirna rakṣito hṛto'bhimanyuḥ kriyatāṃ vyapatrapā || 1 || iti (tataḥ praviśato bhīṣmadroṇau|) droṇaḥ- sūta! kathaya kathaya| raṇapaṭurupanītaḥ kena me śiṣyaputraḥ ka iha mama śaraistairdaivatairyodghukāmaḥ| kathaya puruṣasāraṃ yāvadastraṃ balaṃ vā balavata iṣudūtāṃstatra sampreṣayāmi || 2 || bhīṣmaḥ- sūta! kathaya kathaya| bhagnāpayāneṣvanabhijñadoṣastāruṇyabhāvena vilambamānaḥ| kenaiṣa hastigrahaṇodyatena yūthe prayāte kalabho gṛhītaḥ || 3 || (tataḥ praviśati duryodhanaḥ karṇaḥ śakuniśca) duryodhanaḥ- sūta! kathaya kathaya| kenāpanīto'bhimanyuḥ| ahamevainaṃ mokṣayāmi| kutaḥ, mama hi pitṛbhirasya prastuto jñātibhedaḥ stadiha mama ca doṣo vaktṛbhiḥ pātanīyaḥ| atha ca mama sa putraḥ pāṇḍavānāṃ tu paścāt sati ca kulavirodhe nāparādhyanti bālāḥ || 4 || karṇaḥ- atisnigdhamanurūpaṃ cābhihitam gāndhārīmātaḥ| mā tāvat svajanadhiyā tu bālabhāvād vyāpannaḥ samaramukhe tava priyārtham| asmābhirna ca parirakṣito'bhimanyurgṛhyantāṃ dhanurapanīya valkalāni || 5 || śakuniḥ- bahunāthaḥ khalu saubhadraḥ| mukta eveti sampradhāryatām| kutaḥ, muñcedarjunaputra ityavagato rājā virāṭaḥ svayaṃ smṛtvā cādya raṇājirādapagataṃ muñcet sa dāmodaram| krodhoddhūtahalāt pralambamathanād bhītena mucyeta vā bhīmastvenamihānayed balamahān hatvā ripūnūrjitān || 6 || droṇaḥ- sūta! kathaya kathaya| kathamidānīṃ gṛhītaḥ| paryasto'sya ratho hayā nu capalāścakrākṣamā medinī tūṇī kṣīṇaśare tvamasya viguṇo jyācchedavandhyaṃ dhanuḥ| etā daivakṛtā bhavanti rathināṃ yuddhāśrayā vyāpado bāṇairapyavakṛṣyate khalu paraiḥ svādhīnaśikṣastu saḥ || 7 || sūtaḥ- āyuṣman! puruṣamayo dhanurvedaḥ| kimāyuṣmatā na jñāyate| na cāpi doṣā bhavatābhibhāṣitāḥ sa cāpi bāṇaughamayo mahārathaḥ| alātacakrapratimastu me ratho gṛhīta evāpatatā padātinā || 8 || sarve- kathaṃ padātineti| droṇaḥ- atha kīdṛśaḥ sa padātiḥ| sūtaḥ- kimabhidhāsyāmi rūpaṃ vā parākramaṃ vā| bhīṣmaḥ- rūpeṇa striyaḥ kathyante| parākrameṇa tu puruṣāḥ| tat parākramo'syābhidhīyatām| sūtaḥ- āyuṣman! duryodhanaḥ- kimarthaṃ stūyate ko'pi bhavatā garvitākṣaraiḥ| kathyatāṃ nāsti me trāso yadyeṣa pavano jave || 9 || sūtaḥ- śrotumarhati mahārājaḥ| tena khalu, laṅghayitvā javenāśvān nyasta āpaskare karaḥ| prasāritahayagrīvo niṣkampaśca rathaḥ sthitaḥ || 10 || bhīṣmaḥ- tena hi nyasyantāmāyudhāni| sarve- kimartham| bhīṣmaḥ- hṛtapravego yadi bāhunā ratho vṛkodarasyāṅkagataḥ sa cintyatām| purā hi tena drupadātmajāṃ haran padātinaivāvajito jayadrathaḥ || 11 || droṇaḥ- samyagāha gāṅgeyaḥ| bālyopadeśāt prabhṛtyahaṃ tasya javamavagacchāmi| iṣvastraśālāyāṃ hi, karṇāyate tena śare vimukte vikampitaṃ tasya śiro mayoktam| gatvā tadā tena ca bāṇatulyamaprāptalakṣaḥ sa śaro gṛhītaḥ || 12 || śakuniḥ- aho hāsyamabhidhānam| bhoḥ! pṛcchāmi tāvad bhavantam| nāstyanyo balavām̐lloke sarvamiṣṭeṣu kathyate| jagavdyāptān bhavantaḥ kiṃ sarve paśyanti pāṇḍavān || 13 || bhīṣmaḥ- gāndhārarāja! sarvamanumānāt kathyate| vayaṃ vyapāśritya raṇaṃ prayāmaḥ śastrāṇi cāpāni rathādhirūḍhāḥ | dvādeva dobhyāṃ samare prayātau halāyudhaścaiva vṛkodaraśca || 14 || śakuniḥ- ekenaiva vayaṃ bhagnāḥ sahasā sāhasapriyāḥ| uttaraṃ ca tamapyeke kathayiṣyanti phalgunam || 15 || droṇaḥ- bho gāndhārarāja! atrāpi tāvad bhavataḥ sandehaḥ| kimuttareṇāpi raṇe vikṛṣyate nisṛṣṭaśuṣkāśanigarjitaṃ dhanuḥ| 30 kimuttarasyāpi śarairhṛtātapaḥ kṛto muhūrtāstamito divākaraḥ || 16 || bhīṣmaḥ- gāndhārīmātaḥ! vispaṣṭaṃ khalu kathyate| nanu jānīte bhavān| bāṇapuṅkhākṣarairvākyaijryājihvāparivartibhiḥ| vikṛṣṭaṃ khalu pārthena na ca śrotraṃ prayacchati || 17 || (praviśya) sūtaḥ- jayatvāyuṣmān| śāntikarmānuṣṭhīyatām| bhīṣmaḥ- kimartham| sūtaḥ- ucitaṃ te purā kartuṃ dhvaje bāṇapradharṣite| ayaṃ hi bāṇaḥ kasyāpi puṅkhe nāmābhidhīyate || 18 || bhīṣmaḥ- ānaya| (sūta upanayati|) bhīṣmaḥ- (gṛhītvā nirīkṣya) vatsa! gāndhārarāja! jarāśithilaṃ me cakṣuḥ| vācyatāmayaṃ śaraḥ|) śakuniḥ- (gṛhītvānuvācya) arjunasya| (iti kṣipati| droṇasya pādayoḥ patati|) droṇaḥ- (śaraṃ gṛhītvā) ehyehi vatsa! eṣa śiṣyeṇa me kṣipto gāṅgeyaṃ vandituṃ śaraḥ| pādayoḥ patito bhūmau māṃ krameṇābhivanditum || 19 || śakuniḥ- mā tāvad bhoḥ| śarapratyaya idānīṃ śraddhātavyam| yaudhaḥ syādarjuno nāma tenāyaṃ cojjhitaḥ śaraḥ| likhitaṃ cottareṇāpi prakāśamupanīyatām || 20 || duryodhanaḥ- teṣāṃ rājyapradānārthamanṛtaṃ kakṣyate yadi| rājyasyārdhaṃ pradāsyāmi yāvad dṛṣṭe yudhiṣṭhire || 21 || (praviśya) bhaṭaḥ- jayatu mahārājaḥ| virāṭanagarād dūtaḥ prāptaḥ| duryodhanaḥ- praveśyatām| bhaṭaḥ- yadājñāpayati mahārājaḥ| (niṣkrāntaḥ) (tataḥ praviśatyuttaraḥ|) uttaraḥ- adhvānamalpamatimuktajavaisturaṅgairāgacchatā pathi rathena vilambitaṃ me| kaunteyabāṇanihatairdviradaiḥ samantād duḥkhena yānti turagā viṣamā hi bhūmiḥ || 22 || (praviśya kṛtāñjaliḥ) bho bho! ācāryapitāmahapurogaṃ sarvarājamaṇḍalamabhivādaye| sarve- āyuṣmān bhava| droṇaḥ- kimāha tatrabhavān virāṭeśvaraḥ| uttaraḥ- nāhaṃ tatrabhavatā preṣitaḥ| droṇaḥ- atha kena tvaṃ preṣitaḥ| uttaraḥ- tatrabhavatā yudhiṣṭhireṇa| droṇaḥ- kimāha dharmarājaḥ| uttaraḥ- śrūyatām uttarā me snuṣā labdhā pratīkṣe rājamaṇḍalam| tatraiva kimihaivāstu vivāhaḥ kva pravartatām || 23 || śakuniḥ- tatraiva tatraiva| droṇaḥ- ityarthaṃ vayamanītāḥ pañcarātro'pi vartate| dharmeṇāvarjitā bhikṣā dharmeṇaiva pradīyatām || 24 || duryodhanaḥ- bāḍhaṃ dattaṃ mayā rājyaṃ pāṇḍavebhyo yathāpuram| mṛte'pi hi narāḥ sarve satye tiṣṭhanti tiṣṭhati || 25 || droṇaḥ- hanta sarve prasannāḥ smaḥ pravṛddhakulasaṅgrahāḥ| imāmapi mahīṃ kṛtsnnāṃ rājasiṃhaḥ praśāstu naḥ || 26 || (niṣkrāntāḥ sarve|) tṛtīyo'ṅkaḥ| avasitaṃ pañcarātram|
